name: Lift External Link Notice
author: bradleywatson

sections.description:
Lift External Link Notice adds a configurable leaving-site notice for external links. It is designed for websites that need a clear outbound-link disclosure, including financial institutions, healthcare organizations, associations, and other compliance-sensitive sites.

The plugin does not require Elementor, Elementor Pro, popup builders, custom link classes, React, or build tooling. Once activated, it watches normal frontend links, ignores same-domain links, skips whitelisted domains or URLs, and shows a modal notice before the visitor continues to an external site.

Features:

  • Intercepts normal external link clicks on the frontend.
  • Ignores same-domain, hash, empty, javascript, mailto, tel, admin, and editor links.
  • Optional whitelist for trusted domains or full URLs.
  • Optional whitelist for all subdomains of the current site domain.
  • Continue and cancel button labels can be edited.
  • Empty button labels hide that button.
  • Overlay, modal, text, title, button, and hover colors.
  • Font family selector.
  • Pixel-based style controls for modal width, spacing, typography, padding, gaps, and border radius.
  • Global responsive controls with optional desktop, tablet, and mobile overrides.
  • Live desktop, tablet, and mobile preview in the WordPress admin.
  • Overlay click and Escape-key closing options.
  • No visitor tracking and no external services.
  • Master enable/disable toggle for turning the notice on or off without deactivating the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Lift External Link Notice in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Lift External Link Notice.
  4. Configure the notice content, whitelist, behavior, and styling.
  5. Test an external link on the frontend while logged in and logged out.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor?

No. This is a standalone WordPress plugin and works without Elementor.

Does this use a popup builder?

No. The notice modal is built into the plugin and configured from a normal WordPress settings page.

Will this affect internal links?

No. Same-domain links are ignored. You can also whitelist trusted external domains or full URLs.

Will this always show for external links?

Yes, unless the link is ignored by design, such as mailto:, tel:, admin/editor links, same-domain links, or entries you add to the whitelist.

Does this plugin contact external services or track visitors?

No. The plugin does not send visitor data to external services and does not track visitors.
